$comment: Optional emphasis buckets, saved as data/archetypes.json in your workspace. A bucket groups the kinds of roles you target so a resume can lead with the matching evidence. Jobe ships NO buckets and works without this file: every posting is then labeled General and evidence is ranked by overlap with the job description alone. Define buckets only if your target roles fall into clearly different kinds. Shape: { "<Bucket name>": { "keywords": ["<word or phrase that marks this kind of posting>"], "portfolioDomains": ["<optional heading in your reference.md>"] } }. A posting gets the bucket whose keywords appear most often in its description. Use the same bucket names in the optional archetypes list of each bullet in data/bullet-library.json and in the optional archetype of a row in data/queries/seeds.json. A bucket is only ever a small ranking bonus, never a filter. Keys that start with $ are notes and are ignored, so this file defines no bucket until you add one next to them.

$examples.$comment: Two unrelated fields, to show the shape only. Neither is a default. Write your own bucket names and keywords from your own field.
